title: Jagannath Temple, Puri

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Terrarium terrain on the public approach east of the Lion Gate and fortified wall.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors; Hunter 1872 Plate VI for estimated main hall registration
mapIdentity.scope: The native mapped outer wall and four gate outlines fix the compound and tethers. Plate VI of Hunter (1872) places the four main hall masses on the inner west–east axis, scaled by the current mapped east to west gate distance. The temple authority confirms the axial order and roof types.

note: The unchanged original terrain tile fixes the site grade. At the eastern Lion Gate the cleared Qualla photo shows the plinth, lintel, shallow front pavilion, stepped cap, pillar and the scale relation with the wall. Plate V and the current temple authority records control the four hall silhouettes.
